results.title: Intersection
results.overview: Over the course of a single day the lives of innocent and not-so-innocent individuals collide in a web of misfortune and redemption.

results.title: 32 Hours
results.overview: Aniq (played by Aiman Hakim) is married to Aishah (Sharifah Husna), the only daughter of Dr. Nazir (Datuk Yusry Abdul Halim). Despite being married for a while, the couple still lives in Dr. Nazir's house. Aniq plans to move out once they purchase their own home, but Aishah continually postpones the move.  On Dr. Nazir's 50th birthday, Aishah gifts him a new advanced bicycle. Excited, Dr. Nazir invites Aniq to test out the bike, but Aniq declines as he has plans with his friends. The next day, Aniq's friend cancels their plans, and Dr. Nazir seizes the opportunity to invite Aniq for a bike ride.  During their ride in the forest, a series of events unfold, leading them to become lost for 32 hours.

results.title: No limit
results.overview: Mix a good amount of Monty Python, a touch of the Marx Brothers, a splash of Buster Keaton, a hint of Benny Hill, shake it all up, and you get 'No Limit.' Friday, May 13, 1964, it's the Cold War, but in reality, it's hot. A group of American bombers has mistakenly received the order to bomb Moscow. We need to remind you. There isn't much time... But a little. But not much. Just a little. So stay calm.

results.title: Stellar
results.overview: In one day-night journey, two young sisters, recollect memories of their recently deceased father. Encountering the cruel world of grown-ups, they keep the ultimate freedom that only kids have. Only way they can fight is to stick together.

results.title: Line Of Control
results.overview: In 1993 Kashmir, a teenager searching for his missing best friend is forced by an Indian Army captain to collect ID cards from a valley of corpses, becoming an outcast in his own village while fearing his friend may be among the dead. Based on the novel "The Collaborator" by Mirza Waheed.

results.title: Artificial Disintelligence
results.overview: Twelve years after the effervescent I Think I Love You, the 107 Fauns return to making (being) cinema. Artificial Disintelligence accompanies the guardians of indie from La Plata in the investigation, between pataphysics and the detectivesque, of a mysterious event captured in one of their shows.

results.title: Oru Anweshanathinte Thudakkam
results.overview: In Kerala, an investigating journalist disappears without notice. Media and public stunned. Investigation uncovers shocking, unexpected mysteries. Suspenseful plot follows the case's twists and revelations.

results.title: Absalom Filipino
results.overview: A short film about genocide. - Short film by Lav Diaz, shot for the 60th anniversary of the Austrian Film Museum.

Inspired by Chris Marker's iconic 1962 featurette La Jetée; the year is 2073—a not-so-distant dystopian future—and the setting is New San Francisco, the scorched-earth tech-dominant police state where democracy and personal freedom have been well and truly obliterated.

results.title: Last Stop: Rocafort St.
results.overview: Laura has recently started working in the Barcelona subway. She has been assigned the old and quiet Rocafort station, but it won't be long before she discovers that this stop harbors a legend that will begin to haunt her: many people have died there in strange circumstances over the years and no one seems to be interested in knowing the truth.

results.title: Slice
results.overview: A shocking story at a sobriety meeting leads to several tales of men who have given up their manhood for fame or drugs

results.title: Bisons
results.overview: “Respect for the vanquished”, remarks Steve “is what separates man from beast.” As a champion in Swiss-style wrestling, Steve knows a thing or two about observing codes of combat. But when his family farm faces repossession, he is forced to join hands with his ex-convict brother Joel and enter the lucrative, clandestine world of no-rules fighting.

results.title: The Heritage
results.overview: A traumatized man confronts his dark side at a dinner party and suddenly faces a drastic life-or-death decision.

results.title: Bogotá: City of the Lost
results.overview: After moving to Bogotá for a chance at a better life, a young Korean man rises through the Colombian black market — risking peril for a shot at success.

results.title: Muck
results.overview: Having to poop, a man rushes to the bathroom. Except it's not a bathroom; it's a janitor's closet.

results.title: Qaragh (Wake Up)
results.overview: An ex-soldier suffering from PTSD decides to visit his mother in his remote home village in an attempt to find some peace of mind. He participates in a mystical Spring cleansing ritual set around a temple inside a 13th-century cemetery in the middle of the forest, where he encounters a mysterious little girl. His innocent alter-ego brings him face-to-face with his inner demons and sets him on a difficult path to acceptance and redemption.

results.title: Youthless
results.overview: Welcome to a world where the adults act like kids, so the kids must act like adults.’⁣ Set in the early 2000s, and inspired by director Jordon Scott Kennedy's own childhood, Youthless explores the adultification of three thirteen-year kids on a council estate in Bradford, as they embark on the last day of the school holidays - and unknowingly of their childhoods too.⁣

results.title: My Coach
results.overview: Kec, an amateur boxer, prepares for a tournanametn, dutifuly performing the tasks given to him by his coach.

results.title: Dormitory
results.overview: Forced to leave the comfort of his middle class lifestyle at his father's behest, fourteen-year-old Ahmet is sent to an all-boys religious dormitory where he must navigate familial expectations, his religious obligations, and the childhood to which he so desperately clings.
